start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Joyful Feast
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Lanterns sway. Laughter rises.
The bride and groom dance.

slip_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Return
slip_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The feast still calls you.
Go back.

shortage.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Last Cup
shortage.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Whispers spread: the wine is gone.
Mary's eyes find her son.

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Speak
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The guests will notice.
Do not pretend.

mother.title: [TODO:pt-BR] His Mother's Voice
mother.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "They have no more wine," she says.
Then turns to you.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Trust Her Words
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] She has already spoken.
Obey her son.

instruct.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Quiet Command
instruct.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Jesus points to six stone jars.
"Fill them with water."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Ask why — it is only water
[TODO:pt-BR] Fill every jar to the brim

ask_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Just Do It
ask_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Questions can wait.
Lift the water.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Fill every jar to the brim

half_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] All of Them
half_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He said every jar.
Do not hold back.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Fill every jar to the brim

fill.title: [TODO:pt-BR] To the Brim
fill.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Six jars, full of cool water.
"Now draw some out," he says.

taste.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The First Sip
taste.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The steward's eyes widen.
"You saved the best for last!"

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Be Still
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The wonder is his alone.
Give thanks.

slip2_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Witness It
slip2_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Stay. See what he has done.
Give thanks.

wonder.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The First Sign
wonder.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The disciples look at Jesus.
They believe.
